visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a small red ceramic bowl filled with thick, creamy peanut butter. A metal knife scoops into the paste, lifting it to show a thick, viscous texture against a wooden background and red-checkered cloth. (2) Hands wearing translucent plastic gloves hold a clear glass bowl of roasted peanuts and pour them into a clear plastic bag on a wooden table. (3) The gloved hands vigorously rub and massage the plastic bag containing the peanuts, pressing them against the table surface repeatedly. (4) The bag is opened, and the peanuts are poured into a metal sieve placed over a large glass bowl to separate the brown skins. (5) Hands rub the peanuts inside the sieve, and a transition reveals only the discarded brown skins in the glass bowl. (6) The peeled peanuts are poured from the sieve into a clear blender container. (7) A small amount of white sugar is poured from a glass cup into the blender with the peanuts. (8) The pink blender lid is closed, and the machine starts, showing the peanuts being ground into a fine yellow powder. (9) A hand pours golden-green olive oil from a dark glass bottle with a yellow label into the blender's peanut mixture. (10) The blender continues to run, transforming the powder into a smooth, shiny paste. (11) The finished peanut butter is poured from the blender back into the small red ceramic bowl. (12) A knife spreads the smooth peanut butter onto a slice of toasted white bread. (13) The final scene shows the bowl of peanut butter, the toast, and the olive oil bottle on the table, with two hands appearing at the bottom giving thumbs-up gestures.

The narrator explains the blender; pouring sounds and the click of the blender lid are audible. (7) High-pitched mechanical whirring of the blender begins, overlaid with the narrator's instructions. (10) A 'ding' sound and another 'whoosh' mark the completion of the sauce. (11) A thick squelching sound as the paste is poured into a bowl. (12) A metallic scraping/spreading sound against toast.
